mentions.name: Durable ECS system
mentions.description: A durable Entity Component System (ECS) aimed mostly at games but generally useful, built to exercise a storage engine with Git-like properties. It targets instant durability: powering the computer off at the mains mid-run and restarting should resume instantly with no loading phase. The lower layers are working and the ECS layer and its API design are being mapped out.
mentions.problem: Applications can't survive being powered off mid-run and instantly carry on without a loading phase.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a durable ECS system, mostly for games, though generally useful.  It's to exercise a storage engine I have been building with Git like properties.
